Definition: to shrink, i.e. thicken (as unracked wine, curdled milk, clouded sky, frozen water)
BiblicalUsage: v; 1) to thicken, condense, congeal, settle, become dense; 1a) (Qal) to be condensed; 1a1) thickening (participle); 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to curdle; n m; 2) congelation
